  LinkVerdict (packages/render-template/src/links.ts)
    export type LinkVerdict = {
        ok: true;
        href: string;
        host: string;
        hostUnicode?: string;
        path: string;
        ip: boolean;
        insecure: boolean;
    } | {
        ok: false;
        reason: LinkRefusalReason;
        scheme?: string;
        shown: string;
    };
